answer: Make reward concave in identity count: an actor's payout scales with the square root of its total attested work, never linearly. So splitting one well-tended garden of honest effort into many masks shrinks the combined take — the tide of yield recedes the more you fork. A sybil fleet, each identity only a dim ember of real output, earns strictly less together than one consolidated node would, so every fake an attacker mints costs it forfeited reward instead of multiplying it.
